# exo_events_from_email_configuration (Resource)

Manages the EventsFromEmailConfiguration configuration via Set-EventsFromEmailConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `create_events_from_email_as_private` (Boolean) Maps to the -CreateEventsFromEmailAsPrivate parameter.
- `event_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -EventReservationProcessingLevel parameter.
- `flight_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -FlightReservationProcessingLevel parameter.
- `food_establishment_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -FoodEstablishmentReservationProcessingLevel parameter.
- `invoice_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -InvoiceProcessingLevel parameter.
- `lodging_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -LodgingReservationProcessingLevel parameter.
- `parcel_delivery_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -ParcelDeliveryProcessingLevel parameter.
- `rental_car_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -RentalCarReservationProcessingLevel parameter.
- `reset_settings` (Boolean) Maps to the -ResetSettings parameter.
- `service_reservation_processing_level` (String) Maps to the -ServiceReservationProcessingLevel parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
